facts.statement: Decuriasuchus was first named by Marco Aurélio G. França, Jorge Ferigolo, and Max C. Langer in 2011.

facts.statement: The generic name Decuriasuchus means "unit of ten crocodiles," referencing the ten known specimens.
facts.quote: The generic name means "unit of ten crocodiles" in Latin and Greek in reference to the ten known specimens

facts.statement: All known specimens of Decuriasuchus represent immature individuals.
facts.quote: All known specimens represent immature individuals

facts.statement: The known specimens of Decuriasuchus are around 2.5 meters in length.
facts.quote: The specimens known are around 2.5 m in length

facts.statement: Decuriasuchus quartacolonia is classified as the basalmost member of the clade Loricata.
facts.quote: D. quartacolonia was recovered as the basalmost member of the clade Loricata

facts.statement: Based on growth rate comparisons, an adult Decuriasuchus may have reached a size of approximately 6 meters (20 feet).
facts.quote: an adult Decuriasuchus would reach a size well within the range of known Prestosuchus specimens, 6 metres (20ft.)
